focus.why: Refines the broad frontier 'Disseminated infection' to a specific pathogen. The marked rise in CMV viral load from 63 to 3171 IU/mL, glans penis ulceration, and profound immunosuppression (CD4 140, CVID/HIV) strongly support CMV as the disseminated agent. Chest CT showing only bronchiectasis without consolidation also argues against pulmonary opportunistic infection.
